item.title: Man stole farm tractor, led deputies on chase, Mockingbird County sheriff says
item.description: TESTVILLE, Fla. — A man stole a farm tractor and led Mockingbird County Sheriff's Office deputies on a slow-speed chase Wednesday night before crashing into a pond, deputies said.

item.title: Deputies rescue kayaker in Ohio river
item.description: Sample County deputies rescued a kayaker on the river in Ohio on Monday.
